mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% compresses equity discount rates and stimulates risk-taking, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL indicate monetary policy responding to inflation, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as markets price a soft landing.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1500 thousand units) signal robust consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in PAYEMS and rising UNRATE indicate labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as corporate hiring slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 1500 thousand units) signal weak consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1500, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales (RSAFS) above historical averages signals strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above 5-year average, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals recessionary labor market conditions, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as corporate hiring freezes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.
